audit_directive: Owner Directive Section 6 - Resolution of 2,145 INDEXED Test/Tool Callables

critical_untested_production_areas.description: Zero domain or integration tests verify non-EGP currencies, exchange rate conversions, or multi-currency ledger postings.
Zero tests assert hardware-level transmission of raw drawer kick pulse (DLE DC4) or paper cut (GS V) bytes to physical spoolers.

critical_untested_production_areas.area: Network Drop Recovery During Electronic Payment
critical_untested_production_areas.description: Zero integration tests simulate network drop or socket timeout during credit card/electronic terminal settlement, leaving split-brain state.
Zero integration tests execute split cash+card checkout followed by electronic confirmation; missed primary key collision in FinancialJournalEntries.
Zero tests assert refund rejection when IsPaid is false on COD deliveries.
Zero multi-threaded integration tests verify concurrent payments against the same purchase order.

environment_coupling_hazards.hazard: Hardcoded Local File Paths in FalahApiFactory
environment_coupling_hazards.impact: Tests immediately crash with DirectoryNotFoundException on systems without an E: drive, preventing standard CI pipeline execution.
Requires local SQL Server Express with Windows Authentication; fails on Linux CI, containerized runners, and cloud runners.

environment_coupling_hazards.mechanism: Factory Dispose drops database, but if test runner aborts or crashes, .mdf/.ldf files remain permanently allocated under E:\SqlData\Tests.
